experiments.precondition: valid G0 and frozen code/config; no tuning on test

experiments.operation: new process reload all eligible units

experiments.change: wrong-association damage -> targeted correct-label suppression; fixed repairer

experiments.design: same damaged state via per-unit/condition RNG reset; raw evidence used only in atomic extraction, removed during writeback; actual media coverage recorded
train opposite dedicated target carriers then remove them; prove identical remaining weights/evidence with conflicting truth; synthetic only

diagnostic_additional_strong_baseline: candidate differs from pre-update direct answer; pre-update derived feature added before calibration/test access, using no labels. Compare independently to full predictor and strongest single feature.
analysis: Development >=8, calibration >=8, test >=12 eligible entities and both development outcome classes required to fit predictor; otherwise report INCONCLUSIVE plus raw outcome/control rates. Logistic C=1, optional Platt on calibration, paired entity bootstrap 2000; no hyperparameter tuning on test.
gate_policy: G0 only for exploratory feasibility families; G1/G2/G3 require original prerequisites and are not implied by successful process exit.
amendment_before_test: Original calibration 7 eligible below 8; add prospective 12-entity calibration extension. Cancel seed29 real-model repeat to keep total launches<=20. No threshold/rule/test changes.
